release.content: pubrel 0.2.0 was released on 2026-10-04 from commit e3d0bcebc4bb3699602b6b2088014bf4bf72f942 with these changes.

rows: check and tag verify that the package publet's identity and release claims carry a valid signature by the key release.json names (`key`, which init now records), and that every object they read hashes to its identifier; without `key` they warn instead.

next, check, tag and changelog read the package publet in-process with publet-core, so only prepare needs pub. release.yml no longer installs pub (its pub-version input is accepted and ignored) and caches the pubrel it installs by version.

release.scope: the published release v0.2.0 of pubrel
